commits.subject: Scope TUI app directory state to the active context (#38743)
evidence: Defer: TUI connectors scope batch. Go TUI has no connector directory scope-generation invalidation, stale-request rejection, or AppListUpdated revalidation (tracked for a dedicated TUI batch).

commits.subject: Remove the TUI test dependency on `codex-cli` (#38746)
evidence: N/A: Rust compile/test-infra dependency removal; Go TUI tests have no codex-cli dependency.

commits.subject: Forward workload identity context during token exchange (#38767)
evidence: go test ./auth ./envutil -count=1

OPENAI_WORKLOAD_IDENTITY_CONTEXT read from the process env, forwarded unchanged as the workload_identity_context exchange field, included in the session fingerprint (different values cannot share an exchange), and added to envutil non-inheritable launch-context scrubbing.

commits.subject: Use paginated history for persistent exec threads (#38774)
evidence: Defer: Go's exec runner stays on Rust's legacy fallback (the thread store rejects paginated encoding for exec item shapes). Fresh persistent exec threads would require every exec session item to convert to paginated core form, but plain function_call/custom_tool_call items (and tool outputs) lack the appserver's command/dynamic markers, so the rollout paginated encoder rejects them. Tracked: align exec tool-item building with appserver sessionItemForAppToolCall before enabling paginated history for fresh exec threads.

commits.subject: Keep active-turn model settings stable across updates (#38785)
evidence: Equivalent: Go resolves model, provider, reasoning effort, service tier, approval policy, and parallel-tool-call settings once at turn start into appTurnRunConfig and hands them to the turn AgentLoop; mid-turn thread/config updates therefore cannot change the active turn's sampling requests, matching Rust's step-scoped snapshot.

commits.subject: Show resume and fork status during TUI startup (#38788)
evidence: Defer: TUI startup batch. Go's bubbletea startup flow has no provisional-composer loading-message surface equivalent to Rust's StartupDraft session-action status (tracked for a dedicated TUI batch).

commits.subject: Add storage diagnostics to `codex doctor` (#38795)
evidence: go test ./doctor -count=1

system.disk check reports CODEX_HOME and worktree free space (warn < 5 GiB, fail < 1 GiB); git.worktree.dev_drive (Windows) reports trusted/untrusted Dev Drive state; feedback doctor report workspace anchoring is N/A because Go has no feedback doctor attachment.

commits.subject: Route executor policy audits through log-only telemetry (#38800)
evidence: go test ./execserver -run TestEmitNetworkPolicyDecisionAuditUsesLogOnlyTarget -count=1; go test ./state -run TestLogDBHandlerDropsFilteredRecords -count=1

Forwarded codex.network_proxy.policy_decision events now carry target codex_otel.log_only; the state LogDBHandler excludes that target from the persistent log while standard logging still receives it.

commits.subject: Add a health endpoint to the code-mode gRPC listener (#38806)
evidence: N/A: Go provides no code-mode gRPC server (codemode is a gRPC client to the standalone Rust host); there is no listener on which a /healthz route could be added.

commits.subject: Add raw config overrides to the TypeScript SDK (#38817)
evidence: N/A: the Go repository does not mirror the TypeScript SDK (npm/codex is the CLI wrapper only); no codexOptions/exec.ts surface exists to extend.

commits.subject: Support metadata staging for reserved thread IDs (#38819)
evidence: N/A: Rust ThreadManager/thread-store internal API for host-owned state before thread start; Go's appserver thread router generates thread IDs at start and has no reserve_thread_id/stage-metadata surface.

commits.subject: Avoid cloning TUI history span content (#38822)
evidence: N/A: Rust TUI allocation micro-optimization in insert_history; Go's history insertion does not clone span content in the same structure.

commits.subject: Avoid allocating per character when decorating hyperlinks (#38823)
evidence: N/A: Rust TUI per-character allocation micro-optimization in terminal_hyperlinks; Go renders hyperlink decorations with a different per-line path.

commits.subject: Add endpoint protection checks to `codex doctor` (#38827)
evidence: go test ./doctor -run TestEndpointCheckLikeRust -count=1

security.endpoint check detects CrowdStrike Falcon, BeyondTrust, Microsoft Defender, SentinelOne (Windows sc query), and Jamf Protect (macOS systemextensionsctl), with product-specific exclusion remediation and complete/partial/unavailable inspection states.

commits.subject: Isolate external editor buffers from sandbox-writable paths (#38830)
evidence: Defer: external editor sandbox-isolation batch. Go's tea external editor writes composer buffers via os.CreateTemp to the system temp dir; protecting them under a sandbox-non-writable codex_home/editor directory requires threading the filesystem policy into the tea model (tracked).

commits.subject: Share editor keymaps across TUI composer components (#38837)
evidence: N/A: Rust TUI Arc allocation sharing between the composer and its textarea; Go's bubbletea composer/textarea share keymap values by copy with identical observable binding behavior.

commits.subject: Identify Mac mini hosts in remote control handshakes (#38840)
evidence: go test ./remotecontrol -count=1

x-codex-host-device-kind: mac_mini header is sent on macOS when system_profiler reports machine name exactly Mac mini (2s timeout, cached successful detection, header omitted elsewhere); parser and header tests cover Mac mini, other names, empty, malformed, and non-macOS omission.
